brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.

requirements.requirement: Compact desk unit with a drawer
requirements.evidence: Build has drawer:0#-1,0#cut on piece:-1,0,0;half-n providing desk drawer; total 7 pieces forming compact 2-level unit

requirements.requirement: Spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform
requirements.evidence: Junction of 0,0 / 0,1 / 1,0 exists (socket s8/s123) and spike was placeable, but setSpikeAccessory platform-sm and platform-lrg both refused TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED - 'this spike cannot carry a platform' per configurator. No spike remains in final build; platform requirement cannot be satisfied in current system

finish.summary: Built compact 2-level desk unit with functional drawer on half-n base. Spike location verified at three-base corner, but platform accessory is blocked by configurator (TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED) so spike+platform requirement is unmet.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
